NATIONAL FOREWORD
This Indian Standard (First Revision) which is identical to ISO 9563 : 2015 'Belt drives - Electrical conductivity of antistatic endless synchronous belts - Characteristics and test method' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO) was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Conveyor Belts Sectional Committee and approval of the Production and General Engineering Division Council.
